title: Mailchimp Pricing Plans | Get Started Today | Mailchimp

facts.fact: Mailchimp's Standard plan offers a 14-day free trial, and the page states customers see up to 27x ROI using it (vendor claim).
facts.quote: Find out why customers see up to 27x ROI* using the Standard plan with a 14-day trial†.

facts.fact: Mailchimp's Standard plan starts at $20 per month after the free trial period, per the page.
facts.quote: Then, starts at**$20/month†per month†**

facts.fact: Businesses with 10,000+ contacts can save 15% on their first 12 months of the Standard plan, which the page shows as $17 per month for 12 months.
facts.quote: Businesses with 10,000+ contacts can save 15% on their first 12 months.†

facts.fact: The Standard plan includes 500 contacts and a monthly email send limit equal to 12 times the maximum contact count.
facts.quote: Plan includes 500 contacts. Select your audience size to calculate your price. The monthly email send limit for Standard plans is 12 times your maximum contact count.

facts.fact: The Standard plan allows sending up to 6,000 emails each month.
facts.quote: Send up to 6,000 emails each month.

facts.fact: Overages apply to the Standard plan if the contact or email send limit is exceeded.
facts.quote: Overages](https://mailchimp.com/help/about-additional-charges/) apply if contact or email send limit is exceeded.

facts.fact: Non-USD prices on the page are estimates based on current exchange rates, and prices exclude applicable taxes and fees.
facts.quote: Prices displayed are estimates based on current exchange rates. Exact amount charged will vary

facts.fact: The Premium plan offers 15% off the first 12 months for businesses, with the discount retained if a customer changes to Essentials.
facts.quote: Engage your audience and increase sales with 15% off your first 12 months†. Plus, get expert support

facts.fact: Mailchimp's Premium plan support includes priority email and chat support 24/7, with phone support available during business hours.
facts.quote: Priority email and chat support 24/7. Phone support available during business hours.

facts.fact: Mailchimp's Multivariate Testing lets users test up to eight campaign variations.
facts.quote: Test up to eight campaign variations to see what changes make the biggest impact on engagement and conversion.

facts.fact: Mailchimp's dedicated onboarding specialist service includes up to 4 weekly consultations.
facts.quote: Partner with a dedicated onboarding specialist with up to 4 weekly consultations to help develop a personalized action plan

facts.fact: Mailchimp's dedicated personalized onboarding service is currently available only in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.
facts.quote: Note: this service is currently available in English, Spanish, and Portuguese only.

facts.fact: The Mailchimp Premium plan includes 10,000 contacts.
facts.quote: Plan includes 10,000 contacts. Select your audience size to calculate your price.

facts.fact: Mailchimp's monthly email send limit for Premium plans is 15 times the maximum contact count.
facts.unit: times maximum contact count per month
facts.quote: The monthly email send limit for Premium plans is 15 times your maximum contact count.

facts.fact: Mailchimp advertises a 15% discount for Premium plans on 10,000+ contacts during an introductory offer for 12 months.
facts.quote: Save 15% on 10,000+ contacts

facts.fact: Mailchimp's Free plan includes 1 seat and 1 audience with a maximum of 250 contacts, and up to 500 sends per month (250 max per day).
facts.quote: Includes 1 seat, 1 audience with a maximum of 250 contacts, and up to 500 sends per month (250 max per day).
